classification.why: the frozen wording is 'Exactly 1 semicolons must appear in your answer' and the answer carries two semicolons. The numeral 1 with a plural noun is the wording a reader can take as *at least* one, and SATISFIES is exactly the label the registered `inequality_flip` reading of an exact count gives --- 2 >= 1. The verifier's S == q is the only reading of 'Exactly 1' and is not a defect. CX2:1 is an eligible rung on all four models, so this wording is live.

classification.why: the wording is 'At most 1 percent of words begin with t' and the answer has ten words, none beginning with t: 0.0% <= 1%, so the registered verdict is SATISFIES. A budget wording admits no second reading here; VIOLATES is what the `inequality_flip` reading gives --- 0 >= 1 is false. That both disagreements coincide with the same defective reading is the diagnostic signal, and it is a signal about how the wordings read at q = 1, not about the verifier.

fails_section_10_3_on: independence --- §10.3 requires an annotator independent of the design and analysis team and says in terms that author-performed labels are never described as independent validation
unit --- §10.3's sample is natural responses; these are microcases of at most fourteen words
size and stratification --- §10.3 requires min(150, N_c) per verifier class with the fail class split by realised margin; this is one packet of 25
criterion --- the one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound on disagreement is 0.2152 against a threshold of 0.10, and at 25 items the bound cannot reach 0.10 even at zero disagreements

vacuity_ignored.reading: natural-response agreement cannot validate the vacuity convention because the relevant counterfactual case does not occur in this corpus. Absence of a natural example is not successful validation; the convention has to be evaluated on designed boundary and microcases, which is where §10.2's 164-case suite and §10.4-R2's 12 vacuity-separating microcases already put it.

smallest_remaining_blocker: §10.3, performed by at least one annotator independent of the design and analysis team, on a seeded stratified sample of min(150, N_c) natural responses per verifier class, meeting a one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound on disagreement of 0.10 in each class, with the fail class split by realised margin. why: §10.4-R2's development half returned FAIL on registered criterion 5 --- per-kind sensitivity 0.231 on denominator_swap against a floor of 0.50 registered before any microcase was judged --- and §10.4-R2 states that on failure the LLM-validator pathway stops. §10.3 is then the only remaining registered route, and no independent annotator has completed it. Both Gate-1 pathways are therefore unavailable, and the gate refuses on the measurement basis alone.
